sections.text_helper: Section 65.8.14 "USART transmit data register (USART_TDR)" in chapter 65 (Universal synchronous/asynchronous receiver transmitter (USART/UART)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 3366.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x28
Reset value: 0x00000000
Bits 31:9 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 8:0 TDR[8:0]: Transmit data value
Contains the data character to be transmitted.
The USART_TDR register provides the parallel interface between the internal bus and the
output shift register (see Section65.5.1: USART block diagram).
When transmitting with the parity enabled (PCE bit set to 1 in the USART_CR1 register),
the value written in the MSB (bit 7 or bit 8 depending on the data length) has no effect
because it is replaced by the parity.
Note: This register must be written only when TXE/TXFNF=1.
